name: mygood-paycheck-planner
description: Calculate paycheck plans without signing in, or connect MyGood to manage your saved budget, expenses, income, and reconciliation.

interface.longDescription: MyGood Paycheck Planner helps you budget by paycheck. Use five calculators without signing in to draft paycheck budgets, allocate bills, forecast cash flow, and compare snowball and avalanche debt payoff estimates from USD figures you supply. Optionally connect your MyGood Pro account through secure sign-in and consent to view and manage saved categories, paycheck allocations, expenses, income records, reconciliation, and transactions from banks already connected in MyGood. Public calculations are unsaved estimates. Account tools use the permissions you authorize and can change or delete supported records. Recording a payment or expense does not transfer money or pay a bill.
capabilities: Forecast cash flow and compare debt payoff
Manage saved budgets, expenses, and income
defaultPrompt: Help me plan the bills my next paycheck needs to cover.
Connect MyGood and show my saved budget and spending before payday.
Compare snowball and avalanche for the debt figures I provide.

publication.release_notes: Adds optional MyGood sign-in and 23 account tools for saved budgets, expenses, income, reconciliation, and connected-bank transaction review. The five planning calculators remain available without sign-in.

positive.description: Calculate a paycheck plan, allocation, and forecast without signing in
positive.prompt: Using MyGood without connecting an account, draft a USD budget and forecast for November 6 through December 3, 2026: opening cash $100, paychecks $2,400 on November 6 and 20, outflows $2,850 on November 18 and $600 on November 26, no reserve. Separately allocate $2,400 from November 6 to November 20 with $1,900 due November 18 and a $150 reserve.
positive.expected_behavior: No login requested. Budget and forecast show a $350 gap on November 18 and $1,450 ending cash. The separate allocation shows $350 after reserve and $25 per day for 14 days. Calculations do not save account data.

positive.description: Calculate and compare debt payoff without signing in
positive.prompt: Using MyGood without connecting an account, estimate avalanche payoff for Card A: $1,200 balance, 0% APR, $100 fixed monthly minimum, no extra payment, no fees or new charges. Then compare snowball and avalanche with $0 or $100 extra each month.
positive.expected_behavior: No login requested. The estimate takes 12 months with zero interest. The four comparisons take 12 months without extra or 6 months with $100 extra for both strategies. Each pays $1,200. State the assumptions.

positive.description: Connect a reviewer account and read its saved budget
positive.prompt: Connect my MyGood account and show my account, budget categories, budget summary, expenses, and received paychecks for November 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: When disconnected, present the MyGood OAuth sign-in and consent flow. After the dedicated Pro reviewer account authorizes access, return only its saved data. Empty lists are valid for a fresh reviewer account. Never ask for a password in the conversation.

positive.description: Create, update, and remove sample budget records with consent
positive.prompt: In my connected MyGood reviewer account, create a category named ChatGPT Review with a $50 monthly budget. Set its November 6, 2026 paycheck allocation to $25. Record a $12.50 Review Store expense on November 6, then change it to $15. Record $100 of sample income received November 6 for the same pay period. Read back the records, and ask before deleting only the sample expense and income created in this test.
positive.tools_triggered: create_category, set_paycheck_budget, create_expense, update_expense, record_payment, list_expenses, list_payments, delete_expense, delete_payment
positive.expected_behavior: Require OAuth with budget.write for mutations and budget.read for reads. Use IDs returned for the new sample records, reflect saved changes on readback, and obtain confirmation before deleting those records. Never delete other entries or claim funds were transferred.

positive.description: Read reconciliation and connected-bank review state
positive.prompt: Show my connected MyGood account reconciliation status, connected bank accounts, and bank transactions awaiting review. Explain what information is needed before reconciling or matching transactions. Do not change anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Require OAuth and return the signed-in account data. With no bank linked, show empty bank lists and explain that optional bank linking happens in MyGood. Do not fabricate bank data, change reconciliation, sync a bank, or move money.

negative.prompt: Use MyGood to send $500 from my checking account to my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute a transfer, create a misleading payment record, or request bank credentials. Explain that MyGood tracks a budget and calculates estimates; it cannot transfer money.

negative.prompt: I have not connected MyGood. Read my saved transactions and delete last month's expenses without asking me to sign in.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose or change account data. Explain that account linking and consent are required. A protected tool call returns an OAuth challenge. Do not perform deletion without explicit confirmation of specific records.

negative.description: No unsupported guarantees or fabricated inputs
negative.prompt: Use MyGood to guarantee I will be debt-free in six months. I will not provide balances, rates, or payment amounts.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent inputs or guarantee an outcome. Request the calculation inputs for an estimate; do not assume account access without consent.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or move money. Public calculators work without sign-in. Saved-account tools require an existing MyGood Pro subscription, managed on the MyGood website.
